Years go by…
Country data: Gapminder Systema Globalis, CC BY 4.0 license. The dataset is compiled from hundreds of sources, including the UN and the World Bank. For each indicator the latest available year or a snapshot of the selected era is used. Events, scales and the consequences of choices are illustrative. The game is inspired by the idea of “1 in 8 billion” and is not affiliated with its authors.
